thesis: Post-earnings gap (FY2026 revenue beat, FY2027 guidance, two gene synthesis deals, insider buying) is holding above the pre-earnings 40.5 level, with a net-cash balance sheet, low dilution risk and no scheduled catalyst before 2027-02-03; healthcare (XLV) is a leading sector in the risk-off regime and 63-day RS is +0.37. Against that, valuation is rich relative to 3-5% organic growth guidance, the gap already faded once (rejection at 48.12), and the stop is under 1 ATR, so this is a pullback-only entry with modest confidence. Entry zone upper bound trimmed from 45.8 (technical card) to 45.29 (2026-11-17 low) because R/R at 45.8 to the 50.06 target is only 1.44; at the 44.75 zone midpoint R/R is about 2.8.
invalidation: Daily close below 43.15 (post-earnings swing low of 2026-11-13); a close below about 40.5 fills the earnings gap.
